title: Zellige eight-point star and cross tiles
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of the eight-point star and cross tessellation in handmade zellige: stars and pointed crosses with grout, steep chipped cut edges, uneven glossy glaze with pinholes and per-piece colour. Use for Moroccan and Andalusian walls, fountains, floors and backsplashes.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python zellige_star_tiles.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: stars_across
parameters.meaning: Stars across the tile width; a cross sits between every four stars.

parameters.name: colour_mode
parameters.meaning: 0 stars take the star colours and crosses the cross colours, 1 every piece picks from both.

parameters.name: grout_depth
parameters.meaning: How far the grout sits below the glaze.

parameters.name: edge_cut
parameters.meaning: Width of the steep cut edge around each piece, in star spacings.

parameters.name: glaze_unevenness
parameters.meaning: Thick and thin glaze: bumps in the surface and darker pools where the glaze is thick.

parameters.name: chipping
parameters.meaning: Chipped edges that show the clay body.

parameters.name: colour_variation
parameters.meaning: Spread of tone between pieces of one colour.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: White stars and cobalt blue crosses with glossy, uneven zellige glaze.

presets.name: emerald_white
presets.description: Variegated emerald stars and white crosses, more stars per tile.

presets.name: honey_terracotta
presets.description: Honey-glazed terracotta stars with dark green crosses and wider joints.

presets.name: souk_mix
presets.description: Small pieces in a mixed palette of blue, green, ochre, white and black.

limits: One layout only: stars sized to meet tip to tip, so the crosses have pointed arms; other star proportions and larger girih patterns are out of scope. Glaze thickness, pinholes and chips are noise-driven approximations; the glaze is opaque colour with no depth or crazing. Colours are artistic. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Eight-point star as the union of two squares, one turned 45 degrees
Star and cross tessellation: stars on a square lattice, crosses as the complement
Signed distance to the nearest of four lattice stars
Per-piece hashing for colour, tilt and roughness
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
